tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card borders and dividers on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and meta info on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active navigation background, progress rings and icons 24px or larger. Too light for small text on surface-100/surface-200 — for inline emphasis pair ink text with an accent icon or underline instead.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (primary buttons, active tab pills).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tag and chip backgrounds, selected-row tint; pair with ink text (accent itself is too light to read here).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive deltas and status text on surface-200; always paired with an up-arrow or word, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Negative deltas, alerts and destructive actions on surface-200; always paired with a down-arrow or word, never color alone.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN', 'Yu Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Large stat numbers in dashboard cards.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta text, timestamps and helper text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between stacked elements within a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards in a dashboard grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gutters between dashboard columns.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hover/focus elevation for cards and modals.
